Assess Tier 1a adduct annotation accuracy

Source: R/CAMERA_evaluation_functions.R
build_anno_accuracy.Rd

For each Tier 1a (and optionally Tier 1a_exp) feature, checks whether CAMERA's adduct neutral mass assignment matches the MS1Match's annotated neutral mass within a given ppm tolerance.

Usage

build_anno_accuracy(eval_full, anchors, ppm_tol = 10, mda_tol = 5)

Arguments

eval_full

data.frame. Output of build_eval_full. Must contain: reference_tier, CAMERA_adduct, and at least one of grp_anno_match or exp_anno_match.

anchors

data.frame. Output of build_anchors.

ppm_tol

numeric(1). ppm tolerance for neutral mass matching. Default 10.

mda_tol

numeric(1). Absolute mass tolerance floor in millidaltons. A match is accepted if either the ppm difference is within ppm_tol OR the absolute difference is within mda_tol mDa. Default 5 mDa, which covers the worst-case truncation error from CAMERA reporting neutral masses to 3 decimal places.

Value

A named list:

per_compound

Per Lib_group annotation accuracy counts (Tier1a/Tier1a_exp only — the established methodology), with columns n_total, n_unannotated, n_annotated, n_correct, n_wrong, coverage_pct, accuracy_pct.

summary

Two-row summary table (one per tier) plus a TOTAL row, with the same columns. Unaffected by the all-tier extension to feature_level below.

feature_level

Row-level table covering EVERY tier (not only Tier1a/Tier1a_exp), one row per feature x compound instance, with feature_name, Lib_group, Compound_name, tier_simple, has_CAMERA_annotation, and annotation_match. Every feature belonging to a compound shares that compound's one true neutral mass (established from its own Tier1a/Tier1a_exp evidence), so CAMERA's adduct call on ANY tier's feature can be checked against it. annotation_match is NA when it cannot be evaluated (no CAMERA annotation present, or the compound has no resolvable neutral mass at all), and TRUE/FALSE only when CAMERA's call was actually checked — joinable into build_compound_instance_table.

Details

  1. Tier-aware adduct column: Tier1a features are evaluated against grp_anno_match; Tier1a_exp features against exp_anno_match.

  2. Multi-annotation aware: CAMERA sometimes assigns multiple adduct annotations to one feature in a single string, e.g. "[M+K+HCOOH]+ 63.128 [M+Na+HCOOH]+ 79.102 [M+H+HCOOH]+ 101.084".The updated code splits the string on adduct boundaries and checks whether any of CAMERA's candidate neutral mass values matches the MS1Match neutral mass within ppm_tol.
